description: Typed business-marketing intent for the FYD campaign compiler. Experience IR (L4), parallel to SiteSpec: BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE -> ACTION PLAN -> CHANNEL ADAPTERS. No channel-specific fields: adapter translates at compile time (e.g. objective acquire_leads -> Meta OUTCOME_LEADS, quarantined in the adapter per meta-to-fyd-map row 4). NOT arbitrary prose: additionalProperties is false everywhere.

approval_policy.description: Authority-ux binding: min tier the compiler must enforce before any post-approval execution action. Refs authority_tiers.py tiers.

bounded.description: Required when min_tier is VERY_HIGH: bounded approval = scope + limit + expiry.

audience_query.description: Structured audience definition. Software executes it as a query; it is never prose.

exclusions.description: Structured exclusion rules (suppression lists, prior customers, employees).

interest_hints.description: Bounded hints for the adapter's targeting translation (e.g. Meta ads_targeting_search). Not targeting DSL.

channels.description: Channel enums. The compiler runs CAPABILITY CHECK against the capability matrix per channel before preview.

creative_refs.description: Refs to Creative nodes in the business graph, or new:<concept-slug> for creative the compiler must generate as a draft (Creative is a draft until approval).

objective.description: FYD intent vocabulary. Mapped from channel enums (Meta OUTCOME_*) in the adapter, never in PING core.

offer_refs.description: Business-graph Service/Offer node ids this campaign promotes. Must resolve in the target BusinessGraph.

title: CampaignSpec
